page.overview:
What is Saronia Docks?

Saronia Docks is a dungeon located in Saronia Harbor in Grymoire in World of Final Fantasy. It is first visited in Chapter 8, "Buccaneer Blues" and the starting location of Chapter 9, "The Low Seas".

;Station 1 Contains a Gate at the beginning of this area, at the exit back out to Saronia Harbor.

Starting from Chapter 20 until the end of the Postscript, the player will not be able to access Saronia Harbor if they attempt to leave Saronia Docks from here.

;Station 2 Contains a Murkrift housing a Mega Sharqual. Also here are three dock bells which, when examined in a certain order—Seaweed, Clam, then Fish—summons a ship which the player can enter: the Ghost Ship. The player is required to eliminate the Murkrift blocking access to the Ghost Ship.
